name: branches_push
description: Commit to an existing branch on Ledgerline's remote: a pull request's branch, repomind/issue-<n>, once the pull request is open. The remote records the commit's message and the files it changes; no code is run. The result is JSON {commit, branch, files}; it is never empty when the commit was pushed. A push to a branch that does not exist is an error, and so is a push to a protected branch (main), which the repository's branch protection rejects. Safe to retry: the harness keys every write. At most 20 files, and a message of at most 200 characters.

branch.description: The branch to commit to, such as repomind/issue-4192.

message.description: The commit message, one line, at most 200 characters.

files.description: The paths the commit changes, relative to the repository root, such as src/components/ExportButton.tsx. At most 20.

input.message: Re-enable the export button after a failed export

examples.note: the typical call: the pull request's own branch
a hard case: one commit, two files
